title: Tethered type
description: Individual letters stretch away from their outline and spring back along a fine elastic tether.
useCase: Turn a short wordmark or type specimen into a tactile, direct-manipulation object.
interaction: Drag a letter and release it, or use arrow keys and Enter
reducedMotion: Direct dragging and keyboard positioning remain available; release returns the letter immediately without oscillation.
limitations: A four-letter specimen with bounded displacement. Resize, host pause and document hiding reset all letters. It is not a text editor or font shaper.
look: Hot-pink full-bleed field with four huge black extra-bold sans-serif capitals spanning the width and a small reset control in the corner.
motion: Dragging a letter pulls it off a faint outline while a thin curved tether stretches from its origin; release springs it back with slight overshoot (stiffness 340, damping 23).
adapt: The return spring is integrated in `tick` (`-340 * g.x - 23 * g.vx`), `place` clamps drags and `paint` writes each glyph `transform` and tether `d`. Replace `letters`, then update `center` and the inline `left` percentages for another word length.
